rows.grounds: compound of mūla (root/base) and aṅguli (finger), indicating the bases of the fingers
locative form indicating the tip or front part
adverb indicating continuation of the same placement procedure
compound indicating the five fingers beginning with the thumb, in locative plural

items.question: On which specific parts of the five fingers beginning with the thumb is placement likewise performed?
premises: The placement is performed at the bases of the fingers.
The placement is also performed at the tips.
This placement applies likewise to the five fingers beginning with the thumb.
items.inference: Therefore, the placement is to be made at both the bases and the tips of the five fingers starting with the thumb.
items.plain_english: Likewise, placement is to be made at the bases and at the tips of the five fingers, beginning with the thumb.
